name: application-up-next-autoplay-card
title: Up-Next Autoplay Card
description: Countdown-to-next-video card components with cancel and play-now actions, for video players and course platforms.
useWhen: Countdown-to-next-video card components with cancel and play-now actions, for video players and course platforms.
avoidWhen: Avoid up-next autoplay card when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Up-Next Autoplay Card uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
